name: Codela Commerce Toolkit
author: codela

sections.description:
Codela Commerce Toolkit brings everyday WooCommerce operations into one modular workspace: notifications, shipment details, stock warnings, payment notifications, order review, support, and event-based workflows.

Choose only the tools your store needs. Every module is disabled by default, and activating the plugin does not automatically send customer messages or webhook data.

Included free tools

  • Agreements and consent: Add configurable distance-sales and pre-information agreements to checkout, record customer choices with order-specific document snapshots, provide archived PDFs, and integrate with WordPress personal-data tools.
  • Notifications and activity: Send administrator emails through WordPress, configure supported WooCommerce event templates, and review delivery results.
  • Shipment tracking: Add a carrier and tracking number to an order, show shipment details in My Account, and send only the shipment updates you enable.
  • Stock alerts: Notify store administrators when products reach low-stock or out-of-stock conditions.
  • Bank transfer notifications: Let customers submit EFT or wire-transfer details from an order and let administrators review each notification.
  • Order protection: Apply configurable rules and flag matching orders for manual review.
  • Order-linked support: Keep customer and administrator messages attached to the related WooCommerce order.
  • Payment plans: Display configurable installment and payment-plan tables on product, cart, and checkout pages.
  • Gift wrap and notes: Offer an optional gift-wrap fee and let customers attach a gift note during checkout.
  • Regional addresses: Add province, district, and neighborhood selectors to Turkish WooCommerce checkout and customer address forms.
  • Live visitor counter: Show a configurable real-time visitor indicator on product pages.
  • Flowboard automation: Connect supported Codela events to internal actions or administrator-configured HTTPS webhooks.
  • Guided setup: Use Codela Brain to find enabled modules that still need configuration.
  • Store Appearance: Give product details and customer account areas one consistent visual language while keeping each surface optional. Product galleries can stay with the theme, use a full-width swipe layout, or use an editorial image flow while WooCommerce retains product, variation, lightbox, and extension-hook behavior.

Designed for controlled setup

Module settings are kept together under the Codela menu. Features that can contact customers or external endpoints require the relevant module, event, and delivery option to be enabled and configured first.

Shipment tracking includes region-aware carrier link templates. These are links, not carrier API integrations: the plugin does not query carriers in the background. Administrators can add or replace carrier names and HTTPS tracking URL templates.

Codela Commerce Toolkit is translation-ready, includes English and Turkish interface files, and declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Optional premium package

A separately distributed add-on adds WhatsApp and SMS delivery, advanced checkout customization, PDF and business documents, cart recovery, payment reminders, review collection, stock synchronization, and delivery delay monitoring. It works alongside the free plugin. Premium code is not included in the WordPress.org package, and the included free tools work without a license or Freemius account connection.

Bundled Libraries

Flowboard includes unmodified distribution files from the libraries below. Exact license texts and source references are also included in modules/webhooks/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

  • React Flow: @xyflow/react 12.10.2, MIT. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xyflow/react/v/12.10.2
  • ELK.js: elkjs 0.12.0, EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later. Codela uses the GPL-3.0-or-later option for WordPress.org distribution. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs/v/0.12.0

Agreements and Consent includes namespace-prefixed PDF runtime libraries. Exact
license texts and source references are included in
modules/kvkk/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

  • Dompdf: 3.1.6, LGPL-2.1. Source: https://github.com/dompdf/dompdf
  • Dompdf PHP Font Lib: 1.0.2, LGPL-2.1-or-later. Source: https://github.com/dompdf/php-font-lib
  • Dompdf PHP SVG Lib: 1.0.2, LGPL-3.0-or-later. Source: https://github.com/dompdf/php-svg-lib
  • Masterminds HTML5: 2.10.1, MIT. Source: https://github.com/Masterminds/html5-php
  • PHP CSS Parser: 9.4.0, MIT. Source: https://github.com/MyIntervals/PHP-CSS-Parser
  • Safe: 2.5.0, MIT. Source: https://github.com/thecodingmachine/safe

External Services

The plugin uses the following external services only in the circumstances described below.

Freemius

The bundled Freemius SDK provides optional account connection, licensing, trials, upgrade checkout, and premium-package updates. If an administrator opts in or uses these features, Freemius may receive site, environment, administrator, account, license, and diagnostic information. Free tools remain available when account connection is skipped.

  • Service: https://freemius.com/
  • Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Twilio WhatsApp API

When the optional premium WhatsApp module sends a test or an enabled notification, it calls Twilio’s API with the configured credentials, sender and recipient numbers, and message text. The text can contain order or customer details selected by the administrator. No request is made before credentials and delivery options are configured.

  • Service: https://www.twilio.com/whatsapp
  • Terms: https://www.twilio.com/legal/tos
  • Privacy: https://www.twilio.com/legal/privacy

Gravatar

The optional My Account layout uses WordPress’s get_avatar() function when avatars are enabled. Unless the site or another avatar plugin supplies a local image, the browser may request it from Gravatar using a hash of the account email and ordinary request data such as IP address and browser details.

  • Service: https://gravatar.com/
  • Terms: https://wordpress.com/tos/
  • Privacy: https://automattic.com/privacy/

Administrator-configured HTTPS endpoints

Flowboard can send order, customer, notification, support, or operational event data to an HTTPS webhook entered and enabled by an administrator.

The optional consent adapter can send email or phone details, consent status, channel, source, order ID, timestamp, and configured site metadata to an administrator-configured HTTPS endpoint.

The optional stock synchronization module can retrieve a CSV from an administrator-configured HTTPS URL. The server receives ordinary request metadata such as the site’s IP address; no customer or order data is included in that request.

No request is sent to these endpoints until the administrator configures and enables the related feature. The receiving provider and its terms and privacy policy are selected by the administrator.

Carrier tracking pages

The shipment module creates links to public carrier tracking pages. It does not contact a carrier merely by saving or displaying shipment information. When someone opens a tracking link, their browser sends the tracking number in the URL and ordinary request information, such as their IP address and browser details, to that carrier.

Built-in templates can link to the providers below. The linked privacy notices are maintained by each provider:

  • Türkiye: Yurtiçi Kargo, Aras Kargo, MNG Kargo, Sürat Kargo, PTT Kargo, HepsiJET, and Kolay Gelsin.
  • Europe and global: DHL, DPD, GLS, UPS, and FedEx.
  • United States: USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL.

Administrators can add or replace carrier URLs. The terms and privacy policy for a custom carrier endpoint depend on the provider selected by the administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Codela Commerce Toolkit from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload its ZIP from Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Codela Commerce Toolkit.
  4. Open Codela > Modules and enable only the modules you want to use.
  5. Open each enabled module’s settings and complete its configuration.

To use an optional storefront layout, enable Store Appearance under Codela > Modules, then open Codela > Settings > Store Appearance. My Account can use the theme or Codela appearance independently. For product galleries, choose the theme/WooCommerce output, the recommended full-width swipe layout, or the editorial image flow.

WhatsApp delivery is available through the optional premium package and requires a Twilio account with valid WhatsApp credentials. Free modules, including Agreements and Consent, can be used without Twilio.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does the plugin send messages or data immediately after activation?

No. The related module, event, and delivery option must be enabled first. Twilio messages also require valid credentials, and external Flowboard deliveries require an HTTPS endpoint entered by an administrator.

Which service sends WhatsApp messages?

The optional premium WhatsApp module uses Twilio’s WhatsApp API. Enter a Twilio Account SID, authentication token, and an approved WhatsApp sender or sandbox number in the module settings.

Does shipment tracking connect to carrier APIs?

No. Built-in carriers are tracking URL templates. Saving or displaying a tracking number does not contact a carrier; a request is made only when someone opens its link. You can add a carrier name and HTTPS tracking URL template in the module settings.

Can I keep my theme’s WooCommerce product and My Account designs?

Yes. Store Appearance is optional, and each surface defaults to the active theme. Product details and My Account can be switched independently. Disable the module at any time to return immediately to the WooCommerce appearance supplied by your theme; saved Codela preferences are retained for later use.

Which product gallery layouts are available?

Theme / WooCommerce leaves the active theme’s gallery presentation untouched. Full-width swipe provides a mobile-first horizontal gallery, while Editorial flow places the essential purchase information after the first image and continues the remaining images below it. The setting does not replace WooCommerce product data, variation selection, zoom/lightbox ownership, or extension hooks. Stores can return to the theme option at any time.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Fixed the mobile My Account pages not scrolling on themes whose wrapper uses transform, filter or similar, by falling back to normal document flow when the fixed shell cannot scroll.
  • Added an instant top progress bar when navigating between account pages, so a pending transition is visible immediately on slower servers.
  • Made account notice buttons (e.g. email verification) render an evenly coloured border across all themes.
  • Declared WooCommerce feature compatibility against the running plugin file so the premium package no longer triggers an HPOS/blocks incompatibility notice.

1.0.5

  • Redesigned the My Quotes account page to use the same card layout as the Orders page, with a status pill, amount, item list, and an improved empty state.
  • Aligned the Orders and Quotes list content and notices flush to the account panel, keeping the 32px desktop inset from the divider.
  • Fixed the missing left border on account notice buttons (e.g. email verification and downloads) caused by a theme-forced translucent border colour.

1.0.4

  • Introduced a monochrome design-token foundation and editorial product layout with variation pills, colour swatches, and a sticky mobile purchase bar.
  • Redesigned the My Account shell with a borderless monochrome look, improved mobile menu, and monochrome billing address cards.
  • Refined order-detail spacing, unified product and summary groups, and moved the track button into the header.
  • Improved cargo card layout with inline track button and numeric dates on mobile.
  • Renamed the address page to “Saved Addresses” and removed the redundant WooCommerce intro heading.
  • Fixed Plugin Check compliance: translators comments, output escaping, and removed development-only tooling from the distribution.

1.0.3

  • Added the independent Store Appearance module with a safe theme fallback and migration of existing My Account appearance preferences.
  • Added an independently selectable product-detail presentation with theme, full-width swipe, and editorial gallery choices while preserving WooCommerce product, variation, lightbox, and extension-hook behavior.
  • Added a lightweight Store Appearance preview and hardened popup initialization during AJAX settings navigation so the first visit never exposes dialog content in the page flow.
  • Improved responsive My Account and order-detail states, including real product thumbnails, a filtered order summary, registry-driven order services, clearer failed-order shipment feedback, and removal of duplicate detail actions.
  • Hardened HPOS order metadata access and free-plus-premium module discovery regardless of plugin load order.
  • Expanded Turkish translations, accessibility fallbacks, regression coverage, and WordPress.org package validation.
  • Moved Agreements and Consent into the free package and WhatsApp Alerts into the optional premium package.
  • Moved Payment Plans, Gift Wrap and Note, and Live Visitor Counter into the free package.
  • Moved the Turkish province, district, and neighborhood address layer into the free package.

1.0.2

  • Refined the responsive My Account, order list, order details, checkout address, and customer preference interfaces.
  • Moved the optional My Account presentation into the independent Store Appearance module with a safe theme fallback.
  • Improved shipment progress, tracking availability feedback, payment notification actions, and order-linked support indicators.
  • Fixed cart recovery timing, template installation reliability, checkout compatibility, and several administrator interface alignment issues.
  • Updated Turkish translations and completed compatibility, security, and package validation.

1.0.1

  • Added an optional, responsive My Account layout with a configurable accent color.
  • Fixed shipment save and status flows and improved order, support, and administrator list behavior.
  • Improved translations, module compatibility, security checks, and WordPress.org documentation.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Added modular notifications, shipment tracking, stock alerts, bank-transfer notifications, order protection, support, and automation tools.
  • Added region-aware defaults, translation support, an HPOS compatibility declaration, and security hardening.
